cards.t: NYSE Parent ICE and Trade[XYZ] Bring Hyperliquid Perpetuals to U.S.
cards.b: Intercontinental Exchange (ICE), the owner of the NYSE, has signed a deal with and invested in Trade[XYZ] to launch regulated perpetual futures built on Hyperliquid in the United States, pending CFTC approval.

per.HYPE: HYPE token rallied double-digits following the announcement of the ICE partnership.

cards.label: STRONG CATALYST
cards.missing: Exact launch date pending regulatory approval.

cards.t: Polymarket Suspends Trading After Security Breach
cards.b: Polymarket temporarily suspended trading and placed its exchange in cancel-only mode after a third-party service provider suffered a security compromise that drained user funds.

per.POL: POL token faced exposure as suspected attacker wallets held roughly $2.65 million following the exploit.

cards.label: NEGATIVE CATALYST
cards.missing: Full details on the third-party provider and user reimbursement schedule.

cards.b: Binance suffered a suspected major hack resulting in billions of dollars in outflows across multiple blockchains, triggering a market slide and price drops for Bitcoin and BNB. Tether and Circle froze nearly $1.8 billion in assets linked to the breach, and Binance pledged to cover all user losses.

per.BNB: BNB dropped over 7% following the news of the exchange hack.
per.BTC: Bitcoin fell back toward the $77,000 level amid market-wide liquidations.
per.ETH: Ether prices slumped alongside broader crypto market declines.

cards.label: NEGATIVE CATALYST
cards.missing: Exact final loss tallies and the full recovery timeline.
